info.name: HUKI EBOOK API
info.description:
HUKI E-Book Platform API Collection

## P3 Response Contract
All responses follow this envelope:
```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "Thành công",
  "data": {},
  "meta": {
    "requestId": "uuid",
    "timestamp": "ISO-8601"
  }
}
```

## Pagination
Paginated responses include:
```json
{
  "pagination": {
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 20,
    "total": 100,
    "totalPages": 5,
    "hasNextPage": true,
    "hasPreviousPage": false
  }
}
```

## Error Responses
```json
{
  "status": "error",
  "statusCode": 400,
  "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
  "message": "Thông báo tiếng Việt",
  "details": [],
  "path": "/api/v1/...",
  "requestId": "uuid",
  "timestamp": "ISO-8601"
}
```
